description: Implementation of a subset of mbstring functions in PHP, including encoding conversions, string manipulation, and character encoding detection, encapsulated within a final class 'Mbstring'.

classes.name: Mbstring
classes.description: Final class providing a partial implementation of mbstring functions in PHP, focusing on encoding conversions, string manipulation, and character detection.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding between specified encodings, handling arrays and base64, HTML entities, and iconv conversions.

methods.name: mb_convert_variables
methods.description: Recursively converts variables to a specified encoding.

methods.name: mb_decode_mimeheader
methods.description: Decodes MIME header string using iconv.

methods.name: mb_encode_mimeheader
methods.description: Triggers a warning that the function is bugged; suggests using iconv_mime_encode instead.

methods.name: mb_decode_numericentity
methods.description: Decodes HTML numeric entities to characters, handling encoding detection and conversion.

methods.name: mb_encode_numericentity
methods.description: Encodes characters to HTML numeric entities, handling encoding and codepoint conversions.

methods.name: mb_convert_case
methods.description: Performs case folding (lowercase, uppercase, title case) on strings with encoding support.

methods.name: mb_internal_encoding
methods.description: Gets or sets the internal character encoding.

methods.name: mb_language
methods.description: Gets or sets the language for mbstring functions.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns supported encodings (only UTF-8).

methods.name: mb_encoding_aliases
methods.description: Provides aliases for encodings, e.g., 'UTF8' and 'UTF-8'.

methods.name: mb_check_encoding
methods.description: Checks if variables are valid for the specified encoding.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects the encoding of a string from a list of encodings.

methods.name: mb_detect_order
methods.description: Sets or gets the order of encodings for detection.

methods.name: mb_strlen
methods.description: Returns string length considering encoding.

methods.name: mb_strpos
methods.description: Finds position of first occurrence of a substring.

methods.name: mb_strrpos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence of a substring.

methods.name: mb_str_split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of smaller strings.

methods.name: mb_strtolower
methods.description: Converts string to lowercase.

methods.name: mb_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts string to uppercase.

methods.name: mb_substitute_character
methods.description: Gets or sets the substitute character for invalid sequences.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Returns part of a string based on start and length.

methods.name: mb_stripos
methods.description: Case-insensitive version of mb_strpos.

methods.name: mb_stristr
methods.description: Case-insensitive substring search.

methods.name: mb_strrchr
methods.description: Finds last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: mb_strrichr
methods.description: Finds last occurrence of a character in a string, case insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strripos
methods.description: Case-insensitive version of mb_strrpos.

methods.name: mb_strstr
methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a substring.

methods.name: mb_get_info
methods.description: Returns internal mbstring settings.

methods.name: mb_http_input
methods.description: Stub function, always returns false.

methods.name: mb_http_output
methods.description: Gets or sets HTTP output encoding.

methods.name: mb_strwidth
methods.description: Returns the display width of a string considering multibyte characters.

methods.name: mb_substr_count
methods.description: Counts occurrences of a substring.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: Returns contents unchanged.

methods.name: mb_chr
methods.description: Creates a character from a Unicode code point.

methods.name: mb_ord
methods.description: Returns Unicode code point of a character.

methods.name: mb_str_pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a certain length with a specified string and padding type.

methods.name: mb_ucfirst
methods.description: Uppercases the first character of a string.

methods.name: mb_lcfirst
methods.description: Lowercases the first character of a string.

methods.name: getSubpart
methods.description: Helper to extract part of string based on position.

methods.name: html_encoding_callback
methods.description: Converts HTML entities to numeric character references.

methods.name: title_case
methods.description: Converts string parts to title case.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Loads unicode data files for case conversion.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Normalizes encoding names to standard form.

methods.name: mb_trim
methods.description: Trims characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: mb_ltrim
methods.description: Trims characters from the start of a string.

methods.name: mb_rtrim
methods.description: Trims characters from the end of a string.

methods.name: mb_internal_trim
methods.description: Internal method for trimming with regex.

methods.name: assertEncoding
methods.description: Validates encoding name.
